answer.explanation: The ThumbnailerFunction fails continuously across the window (about 35-44 errors per minute) with NoSuchBucket on S3 PutObject. Its OUTPUT_BUCKET is set to the nonexistent bucket 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca'. Commit 32da483 (21:11:29Z) changed template.yaml from !Ref OutputBucket to that literal name. The live configuration was updated at 21:12:50Z and matches the template, so the live state is faithful to the IaC change. The IAM policy is not the cause, since the failure is a missing bucket rather than AccessDenied. The code is not implicated; the handler is failing on the environment value it is given.
